title: MessageBird Conversation
description: Represents an omnichannel conversation thread in the MessageBird Conversations API, consolidating messages from multiple channels into a single contact interaction.

id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation.

contactId.description: The unique identifier of the contact associated with this conversation.

channels.description: The messaging channels used in this conversation.

createdDatetime.description: The date and time when the conversation was created.

updatedDatetime.description: The date and time when the conversation was last updated.

lastReceivedDatetime.description: The date and time of the last received message.

lastUsedChannelId.description: The identifier of the last channel used in the conversation.

Contact.description: A contact associated with one or more conversations.

id.description: The unique identifier of the contact.

href.description: The URL of the contact resource.

msisdn.description: The phone number of the contact in international format.

displayName.description: The display name of the contact.

firstName.description: The first name of the contact.

lastName.description: The last name of the contact.

customDetails.description: Custom details associated with the contact.

createdDatetime.description: The date and time when the contact was created.

updatedDatetime.description: The date and time when the contact was last updated.

Channel.description: A messaging channel through which conversations take place.

id.description: The unique identifier of the channel.

createdDatetime.description: The date and time when the channel was created.

updatedDatetime.description: The date and time when the channel was last updated.

id.description: The unique identifier of the message.

conversationId.description: The conversation this message belongs to.

channelId.description: The channel through which the message was sent.

content.description: The message content, structure depends on type.

createdDatetime.description: The date and time when the message was created.

updatedDatetime.description: The date and time when the message was last updated.
